Reject live i registers without DEFI, zero/oversize counts, mixed IF/REP nesting and malformed operands; branch definite-write state and original D3D9 gamepad path remain safe.
Portable C++ regression, integrated source check, exact-SHA Fast, Backend, Win32, OpenXR and HUD Gates all pass before build verified acceptance.

Require exact-SHA five GitHub gates, then obtain separate actual-game/Quest3 evidence
